notes_append: Repository and global advisories are published, unwithdrawn, and directly declare CVE-2026-57148 as the alias of GHSA-F38V-77QJ-H4JQ.
The Cursor hardening adds a production JWT guard but defaults an unset PLATFORM_ENV to dev; the later fix removes that default-open behavior.
PyPI has no 0.1.5 release; the durable release witness is vulnerable 0.1.4 to fixed 0.1.6, matching the reviewed global advisory.
GHSA-239W-M3H6-CH8V is a valid public identity, but the AI commit is its remediation rather than its causal origin.
The only residuals named by the source row are already represented by CVE-2026-55667 delete/permission and CVE-2026-55668 dangling-write components on the same repair chain.
No third non-overlapping mechanism remains, so this umbrella row is preserved as a non-counting REJECT control.
The cold-cache early return is a real contributor and release containment is beta.437 through beta.470, fixed in beta.471.
Conductor officially runs coding agents, but its checkpoints can contain both user and AI changes; the generic auto-commit subject does not atomically attribute this hunk to AI.
Keep UNKNOWN until commit- or PR-level first-party evidence identifies the generating agent or model.

corrections.mechanism: Entity-controlled high-rate writes -> one DynamoDB partition for every bucket of that entity; invariant: bucket writes must spread across independently shardable partition keys before the per-partition WCU ceiling is reached.
notes_append: The Claude-coauthored root commit creates entity-keyed DynamoDB buckets and is contained in vulnerable v0.10.0.
The former 3902c8c2 -> 94a129ae edge was insufficient: 94a only migrates keys and injects metadata; it contains no shard selection, retry, or shard-count doubling.

The six-member atomic closure ends at 9f66c42f, which adds random shard selection, cross-shard retry, and conditional doubling after WCU exhaustion; 20 targeted async/sync tests pass at that exact commit.

The first-party advisory identifies <=0.10.0 as vulnerable and 0.10.1 as patched; v0.10.1 is the official merge carrier 481ce44d. Later aggregator commits improve proactive behavior but are not required for the client-side minimum security closure.

corrections.mechanism: Unauthenticated OAuth consent ha_url -> server request to attacker-selected /api/config and credential-bound tool clients; invariant: the Home Assistant origin must be fixed by server configuration, not OAuth form input.

ai_provenance.marker: Generated with Claude Code; Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

notes_append: PR #368 member aae7acba introduces the user-supplied ha_url form field and the unauthenticated request to {ha_url}/api/config; squash carrier 39806871 preserves the same primitive and is released through v6.7.2.
PR #748 member 0ca572a1 removes ha_url from the form and token claims, deletes _validate_ha_credentials, and makes HOMEASSISTANT_URL server-side; later PR members do not reintroduce the primitive.

The isolated 0ca572a1 tree passes all 46 OAuth unit tests. The published, unwithdrawn repository and reviewed global advisories both map the GHSA to CVE-2026-32111 and name 7.0.0 as the first patched release.
The release edge remains squash carrier 39806871 -> dc8eaa16, while atomic_fix_members records the one minimum semantic fix member instead of treating the carrier as atomic.

corrections.mechanism: A stable lexical workspace alias is hashed directly into the per-project memory namespace, so repointing that alias under a shared HOME reuses another real workspace's MEMORY.md; invariant: project-memory identity must bind to the canonical real workspace with a domain-separated, full-length key.
notes_append: The Claude-coauthored bce0d2ba delta adds initProjectMemory and keys its directory with sha256(literal workspacePath)[0:12]; the commit is exactly tag v0.4.0, and its parent has no per-project memory implementation.

First-party issue #46 identifies bce0d2ba/v0.4.0 as affected and demonstrates cross-workspace memory disclosure through a repointed lexical symlink. The published, unwithdrawn global GHSA formally aliases CVE-2026-14611 and cites the same issue, PR, and fix.

PR #49 is a squash. Its first member c6daf910 is the minimum semantic fix: canonical realpath plus a schema-separated full SHA-256 key. The second member only migrates legacy directories; the isolated c6daf910 tree passes its symlink-isolation test.

No fixed release tag exists in the repository. The global unreviewed advisory simultaneously says v0.4.0 is affected and that upgrading to v0.4.0 fixes it, so that sentence is rejected as contradictory metadata; this row claims a released vulnerable AI origin and commit-level fix, not a released fix version.
